results.new_value:
An analyst gathers the following common-size balance sheet information for three companies:

| Item | Company X | Company Y | Company Z |
|------|-----------|-----------|-----------|
| Cash and cash equivalents | 15.6% | 12.0% | 2.0% |
| Marketable securities | 3.4% | 5.1% | 12.0% |
| Trade and other receivables | 10.9% | 12.7% | 4.8% |
| Total current liabilities | 28.6% | 28.2% | 17.1% |

Q. Based solely on the quick ratio, which company is most liquid?

Quick ratio = (Cash and cash equivalents + Marketable securities + Trade and other receivables) / Current liabilities. Company X: (15.6% + 3.4% + 10.9%) / 28.6% = 29.9% / 28.6% = 1.045. Company Y: (12.0% + 5.1% + 12.7%) / 28.2% = 29.8% / 28.2% = 1.057. Company Z: (2.0% + 12.0% + 4.8%) / 17.1% = 18.8% / 17.1% = 1.099. Company Z has the highest quick ratio and is therefore the most liquid based solely on this measure.
